overview_description.description: TruckSmarter offers drivers a free electronic load board that displays loads from hundreds of brokers in a simple mobile interface, allowing drivers to quickly find the best load. TruckSmarter drivers book the vast majority of their loads through the platform, and brokers whose loads are displayed benefit from access to a larger pool of drivers. Access to more and better loads improves its drivers' quality of life by allowing them to manage their travel and maximize the amount they are paid.

about_short_description.short_description: Our mission is to empower truck drivers lives across the US through technology and grit.

product.name: Free Load Board
product.description: A platform that allows truck drivers and owner-operators to search, bid on, and book freight loads without any fees or subscription costs.

product.name: Fuel Discounts
product.description: A program offering truck drivers discounted diesel fuel prices at hundreds of truck stops across the U.S., accessible via an app without requiring a fuel card.

product.name: Freight Factoring
product.description: A financial service that advances payment to truckers for their freight invoices, typically within hours, in exchange for a fee, helping improve cash flow.

product.name: TruckSmarter Banking
product.description: Banking services tailored for truckers, including a checking account with FDIC insurance, debit card, and features like cash back and fuel discount enhancements.

product.name: TruckSmarter Card
product.description: A Visa debit card linked to TruckSmarter Banking, providing instant access to funds, free ATM withdrawals, and cash back rewards for truck drivers.

product.name: Broker Directory
product.description: A searchable database of vetted freight brokers with credit scores, payment history, bond details, and contact information for trucking businesses.
